args.brief: Chapter 3, "The Duplicate": Tobin—not Ruth—brings Anwen the duplicate page from the records; Ruth remains the keeper of the public records and is consulted only for confirmation of provenance. Anwen reads the handling note, compares the duplicate, keeps the brass case closed and intact, and the team agrees to finish checking before the public demonstration. Precise, quiet practical actions; no injuries.
